        # Process tuple by renaming the left-hand side and recursively handling the right-hand side
        lhs, rhs = child
        lhs = lhs.replace(prefix, replacement, 1)
        rhs = get_child_with_renamed_prefix(prefix, replacement, rhs)
        return lhs, rhs
    elif isinstance(child, F):
        # For F objects, copy and rename
        child = child.copy()
        child.name = child.name.replace(prefix, replacement, 1)
    elif hasattr(child, "resolve_expression"):
        # For objects with resolve_expression, apply recursive renaming to source expressions
        child = child.copy()
        child.set_source_expressions([
            get_child_with_renamed_prefix(prefix, replacement, grand_child)
            for grand_child in child.get_source_expressions()
        ])
    elif isinstance(child, Q):
        # Recursively apply renaming to each child node in Q objects
        for child_node in child.children:
            new_child_node = get_child_with_renamed_prefix(prefix, replacement, child_node)
            child.children = [new_child_node if c is child_node else c for c in child.children]
    elif isinstance(child, str):
        # If it is a string, directly replace the prefix
        child = child.replace(prefix, replacement, 1)
    return child
